title: Live preview of site settings and brand in the newsroom
description:
Outcome: An admin sees a change before saving it: a previewSitePage query renders one page (home, a section, a story) from the unsaved SiteConfig and BrandPack drafts, without writing to S3, and returns HTML shown in a sandboxed frame. Uses the same renderer as publishing, so the preview is exact.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/data/schema.ts (new custom query previewSitePage, additive), amplify/functions/content-actions/handler.py, app/newsroom site settings and onboarding components.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features/site-settings-preview.feature):
Scenario: The preview shows an unsaved colour
    Given an admin changes the brand colour without saving
    When the preview refreshes
    Then the preview page uses the new colour and the public site is unchanged

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-413576. Blocks PPY-810f42. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Browser test; pytest that preview writes nothing.
Rollout: Releasable alone.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: preview becomes a cheap way to run heavy renders. Mitigation: one page per call, metered as function time (PPY-3fd951).

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: changes: adds one query (tenant admin claim).
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
